word-washing-machine.def: a machine that cleans dirty clothes with soap and water

word-tumble-dryer.def: a machine that uses hot air to get the water out of washed clothes

word-vacuum-cleaner.def: a machine that sucks up dust and dirt from floors and carpets

word-iron-appliance.def: a flat metal tool that is heated and rubbed over cloth to remove wrinkles

word-hair-dryer.def: a small electric device that blows hot air to remove water from wet hair

word-air-conditioner.def: a machine that cools the inside of a room or building

word-fan-appliance.def: a machine with turning blades that moves the air to make you feel cooler

word-heater.def: a device that gives off warmth to make a room hotter

word-radiator.def: a metal device on a wall that is filled with hot water and warms a room

word-water-heater.def: a tank in a house that gives you hot showers and hot baths

word-light-bulb.def: a glass globe that shines when electricity goes through it

word-socket.def: a place in a wall where you plug in electrical devices

word-extension-cord.def: a long wire with a plug and several holes, used to reach a faraway outlet

word-remote-control.def: a small device you use to operate a TV from across the room

word-smoke-detector.def: a small device on the ceiling that beeps loudly when it senses fire fumes

word-fuse.def: a small part that breaks and stops the current if there is too much electricity

word-broom.def: a tool with a long handle and stiff bristles used to clean floors

word-mop.def: a tool with a long handle and a soft head used to clean floors with water

word-sponge.def: a soft, light object that soaks up liquid, used for washing

word-rag.def: a piece of old cloth used for cleaning

word-detergent.def: a powder or liquid soap used to wash clothes or dishes

word-bleach.def: a strong chemical that makes cloth white and kills germs

word-trash-bag.def: a large plastic sack for throwing away waste

word-vacuum-v.def: to clean a floor or carpet with a machine that sucks up dirt

word-sweep.def: to clean a floor by pushing dirt away with a long brush

word-iron-v.def: to make clothes smooth and flat using a hot flat tool

word-do-laundry.def: to wash, dry and often fold dirty clothes

word-scrub.def: to rub a surface hard with a brush to get it clean

word-rinse.def: to wash soap or dirt off something using clean water

word-dry-v.def: to take the water or moisture out of something wet

word-sink.def: a bowl fixed in a kitchen or bathroom where you wash hands or dishes

word-tap.def: a device you turn to let water come out of a pipe

word-bathtub.def: a large container you fill with water and sit in to wash

word-toilet-paper.def: a soft roll of thin tissue used in the restroom for cleaning yourself

word-toothbrush.def: a small brush with a handle that you use to clean inside your mouth

word-toothpaste.def: a thick minty cream you squeeze onto a brush to clean the inside of your mouth

word-shampoo.def: a liquid soap used for washing your hair

word-razor.def: a sharp tool used to shave hair from the skin

word-drain.def: a hole or pipe that carries dirty water away from a sink or floor

word-screwdriver.def: a tool with a flat or cross-shaped tip that turns small metal fasteners

word-screw.def: a small pointed metal pin with a spiral line that you turn to hold things together

word-drill.def: a power tool that makes round holes in walls, wood or metal

word-saw.def: a tool with a sharp edge of small points used to cut wood

word-pliers.def: a tool with two arms that grips and bends small things like wire

word-wrench.def: a metal tool that grips and turns nuts and bolts

word-tape-measure.def: a long flexible strip with numbers on it, used to find how long things are

word-adhesive-tape.def: a thin plastic strip with glue on one side, used to fasten paper

word-glue.def: a thick sticky liquid used to join things together

word-paint-n.def: a colored liquid you put on walls or objects to change their color

word-wire.def: a thin, flexible string of metal, often used to carry electricity

word-leak.def: a hole or crack where liquid or gas gets in or out by accident

word-leak-v.def: to let liquid or gas escape through a hole

word-crack.def: a thin line where something has started to break apart

word-mold.def: a fuzzy green or black growth that appears on damp walls or old food

word-door-handle.def: the part you hold or turn to open a room's entrance

word-drill-v.def: to make a round hole in something with a spinning tool

word-plumber.def: a person whose job is to install and repair pipes, sinks and toilets

word-electrician.def: a person whose job is to install and fix wiring and power lines in buildings

word-handyman.def: a person who is paid to do small repairs around the house

word-mattress.def: the soft, thick pad on a bed that you sleep on

word-clothes-hanger.def: a shaped piece of wire, plastic or wood that holds a shirt or dress in a closet

word-power-outage.def: a period when the electricity stops working in a home or area

word-recycling.def: the process of turning used paper, glass or plastic into new things

word-garbage-can.def: a large container with a lid for throwing away waste

word-household-chores.def: the regular jobs like cleaning and cooking that keep a home in order
